title: Retirement Gratuity: How It Is Calculated and the Ceiling
description: Retirement gratuity is one-fourth of emoluments for each six-monthly period of service, up to 16.5 times emoluments, capped at Rs 25 lakh since 01.01.2024.
applies_to: Central Government civil servants under the CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021 or the CCS (Payment of Gratuity under NPS) Rules, 2021
answer: If you have at least five years of qualifying service, your retirement gratuity is one-fourth of your emoluments (basic pay plus DA) for each completed six-monthly period of qualifying service. It cannot exceed 16.5 times your emoluments. From 1 January 2024, the maximum amount is Rs 25 lakh.

sections.heading: The Formula
sections.body_md:
- You must have completed five years' qualifying service and be eligible for service gratuity or pension [(CCS (Pension) Rules 2021, Rule 45(1)(a), PDF p. 74)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/CSS_PensionRules_2021_Book_Eng.pdf#page=74).
- Retirement gratuity is one-fourth of your emoluments for each completed six-monthly period of qualifying service, subject to a maximum of 16.5 times the emoluments [(CCS (Pension) Rules 2021, Rule 45(1)(a), PDF p. 74)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/CSS_PensionRules_2021_Book_Eng.pdf#page=74).
- A fraction of a year of three months or more counts as a completed six-monthly period [(CCS (Pension) Rules 2021, Rule 45(4), PDF p. 75)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/CSS_PensionRules_2021_Book_Eng.pdf#page=75).
- If your qualifying service is four years and nine months or more but less than five years, it is treated as five years [(CCS (Pension) Rules 2021, Rule 45(5), PDF p. 75)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/CSS_PensionRules_2021_Book_Eng.pdf#page=75).
- If the amount has a fraction of a rupee, it is rounded up to the next rupee [(CCS (Pension) Rules 2021, Rule 45(1), second proviso, PDF p. 74)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/CSS_PensionRules_2021_Book_Eng.pdf#page=74).

In short: gratuity = emoluments x 1/4 x number of completed six-monthly periods. Since 66 six-monthly periods give 16.5 times, service beyond 33 years does not raise the multiple.

sections.heading: What Counts as Emoluments
sections.body_md:
- Emoluments means basic pay as defined in FR 9(21)(a)(i) that you were drawing immediately before retirement, plus non-practising allowance for medical officers. Stagnation increment also counts [(CCS (Pension) Rules 2021, Rule 31(1), PDF p. 44)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/CSS_PensionRules_2021_Book_Eng.pdf#page=44).
- For gratuity, the dearness allowance admissible on the date of retirement is also treated as emoluments [(CCS (Pension) Rules 2021, Rule 45(6), second proviso, PDF p. 75)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/CSS_PensionRules_2021_Book_Eng.pdf#page=75).
- If your emoluments were reduced during the last ten months of service, average emoluments are used instead [(CCS (Pension) Rules 2021, Rule 45(6), first proviso, PDF p. 75)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/CSS_PensionRules_2021_Book_Eng.pdf#page=75).

sections.heading: The Rs 25 Lakh Ceiling
sections.body_md:
- The rule as printed in 2021 capped retirement and death gratuity at Rs 20 lakh [(CCS (Pension) Rules 2021, Rule 45(1), first proviso, PDF p. 74)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/CSS_PensionRules_2021_Book_Eng.pdf#page=74).
- The Government accepted the 7th CPC recommendation that the gratuity ceiling may rise by 25% whenever DA rises by 50% [(DoPPW Resolution 04.08.2016, item 8, PDF p. 6)](https://documents.doptcirculars.nic.in/D3/D03ppw/NotifiedResolution-2016.pdf#page=6).
- After DA rose from 46% to 50% from 1 January 2024, DoPPW raised the maximum retirement gratuity and death gratuity by 25%, from Rs 20 lakh to Rs 25 lakh, with effect from 1 January 2024. This covers both the CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021 and the CCS (Payment of Gratuity under NPS) Rules, 2021 [(DoPPW OM dated 30.05.2024, para 3, PDF p. 1)](https://documents.doptcirculars.nic.in/D3/D03ppw/GratuityrAHHB.pdf#page=1).

| Example | Emoluments (pay + DA) | Six-monthly periods | Formula result | Payable |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Rs 1,20,000 | 66 (33 years) | Rs 19,80,000 | Rs 19,80,000 |
| B | Rs 2,00,000 | 66 (33 years) | Rs 33,00,000 | Rs 25,00,000 (ceiling) |

These are worked illustrations of the formula, not official figures.

sections.heading: If You Are Under NPS
sections.body_md:
- NPS employees get retirement gratuity under a separate set of rules, with the same formula: one-fourth of emoluments for each completed six-monthly period, up to 16.5 times emoluments [(CCS (Payment of Gratuity under NPS) Rules 2021, Rule 22(1), PDF p. 28)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/Gratuity_rules_2021_NPS_31122025.pdf#page=28).
- The amended text of those rules caps retirement or death gratuity at twenty five lakh rupees and counts DA on the date of retirement as emoluments [(CCS (Payment of Gratuity under NPS) Rules 2021, Rule 22(2) proviso and 22(3), PDF p. 29)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/Gratuity_rules_2021_NPS_31122025.pdf#page=29).

sections.heading: Where to Check
sections.body_md:
Read Rules 31 and 45 of the CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021 [(CCS (Pension) Rules 2021, Rule 45, PDF p. 74)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/CSS_PensionRules_2021_Book_Eng.pdf#page=74) with the DoPPW OM dated 30.05.2024 [(DoPPW OM dated 30.05.2024, PDF p. 1)](https://documents.doptcirculars.nic.in/D3/D03ppw/GratuityrAHHB.pdf#page=1).

The CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021 cover civilian Government servants in the Defence Services, but not railway servants [(CCS (Pension) Rules 2021, Rule 2 and 2(a), PDF p. 12)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/CSS_PensionRules_2021_Book_Eng.pdf#page=12) or members of the All India Services [(CCS (Pension) Rules 2021, Rule 2(e), PDF p. 13)](https://pensionersportal.gov.in/Document/CSS_PensionRules_2021_Book_Eng.pdf#page=13). Railway staff, AIS officers and armed forces personnel should check their own rules.

faqs.q: What is the maximum retirement gratuity for central government employees?
faqs.a: Rs 25 lakh, with effect from 1 January 2024, under the DoPPW OM dated 30.05.2024. Within that cap, the formula also limits gratuity to 16.5 times your emoluments (Rule 45(1)(a)).

faqs.q: Is DA included when calculating gratuity?
faqs.a: Yes. The dearness allowance admissible on the date of retirement is treated as emoluments for gratuity (Rule 45(6), second proviso).

faqs.q: How many years of service do I need for retirement gratuity?
faqs.a: Five years of qualifying service (Rule 45(1)(a)). Service of four years and nine months or more is treated as five years (Rule 45(5)).

faqs.q: Does an extra three months of service count?
faqs.a: Yes. A fraction of a year of three months or more is treated as a completed six-monthly period (Rule 45(4)).

faqs.q: Do NPS employees get retirement gratuity?
faqs.a: Yes, under the CCS (Payment of Gratuity under NPS) Rules, 2021, on the same one-fourth formula and the Rs 25 lakh ceiling (Rule 22).
